messages:
rachel: Quick heads-up 1: we validated the kernel-prefetcher + early-commit microbatcher on the mixed-prod pool. Solid improvements on tail latency and cost. Starting a staggered rollout to 60% now. :sparkles:

rachel: Summary numbers (prod mix, averaged across 8 workers):
```text
Baseline: p50=30ms, p95=120ms, p99=360ms, cost/token=$0.00160
New:      p50=29ms, p95=95ms,  p99=285ms, cost/token=$0.00112
Impact: p99 -20.8%, cost/token -30%
Hot-path (<=256): p99 -17%
Cold long-context (>6k): p99 -12%, KV eviction rate -28%
```

tom: great numbers. did we see any change in request ordering or determinism? customers using offline replay need to know.

rachel: no reordering. early-commit only commits completed microbatches early if they meet sampling + seed invariants; it doesn't change token ordering. We'll add a note in the runbook and release banner.

vince: curious about GPU stalls. did kernel prefetcher reduce memcpy stalls on small batches?

rachel: yes, host->device memcpy overhead dropped ~35% on average because prefetcher warms work queues and avoids cold memcpy spikes. GPU busy time increased slightly but tail stalls reduced.

maya: any uptick in 5xxs or client retries?

rachel: error-rate stable in the 4h canary. 5xxs unchanged, retries flat. small bump in client timeouts for a tiny fraction of large streaming sessions (<0.02%) - investigating but not correlated with correctness.

tom: rollout plan and rollback gates?

rachel: rollout: canary(1%) -> 5% -> 20% -> 60% (now) -> 100% after 2h stable. gates: p99 regression >3% OR error-rate +0.5% absolute => auto-rollback. rollback = feature-flag flip in infra console and a single-scale-down redeploy. oncall channel subscribed.

oncall-bot: Deploy event: commit=8c9d2fa promoted to 60% in prod. Monitoring: perf-gates OK. Link: https://redwood.internal/deploys/8c9d2fa

vince: can we capture per-seqlen p99 curves for the wiki? will feed into the cost estimator.

rachel: yes, I'll attach detailed bins (0-256,256-1k,1k-4k,4k-8k) and Grafana snapshots to the PR and the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prefetch-early-commit.

maya: please ping support and account leads for customers with streaming-sensitive SLAs.

rachel: done - copying support. planned comms: short console banner + changelog bullet: "Runtime: kernel prefetcher + early-commit microbatching 1% p99 improvement and 30% per-token cost reduction".

tom: nice work. let's meet after 2h to review the 60% hold metrics and decide on 100%.

rachel: agreed. thanks team :raised_hands: 

(automated) metrics recorded: p50/p95/p99, cost/token, gpu-mem, memcpy-latency, kv-evict-rate, error-rate. thresholds in runbook.
